title: Stage 5a Feature Manifest Schema
description: Intermediate artifact produced by Stage 5a. Contains exactly ONE Feature per MFU (1-MFU = 1-Feature principle). Each Feature covers the entire MFU screen (bounding_box.zone_id='FULL_SCREEN'). Enriched with business architecture fields (functions, category, business_context, success_criteria) aligned with the Module → Feature → Function hierarchy from the business architecture specification. Consumed by Stage 5b which populates the Feature with User Stories to produce the final features_stories.json.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the Feature Manifest intermediate artifact. Bumped to 5a.2 for business architecture enrichment fields.

mfu_id.description: Parent MFU identifier (e.g. MFU-001). Links back to Stage 4 config_naming_map.json.

mfu_seq.description: Zero-padded 3-digit sequence extracted from mfu_id (e.g. 001). Used to derive Feature IDs.

module_id.description: Module identifier (e.g. MOD-ANCES). Matches the Module node already present in Neo4j.

module_business_name.description: Refined DDD-quality domain name, hydrated from Stage 2.7 module_manifest.json.

module_business_description.description: Refined business capability description, hydrated from Stage 2.7 module_manifest.json.

source_path.description: Origin path of the primary SRS document, relative to project root.

technology_tag.description: Source technology paradigm (e.g. PowerBuilder, VB6, COBOL).

l1_source.description: L1 traceability — the source document node for this derivation chain.

features.description: List of Features derived from the SRS. Under the 1-MFU=1-Feature rule, this array will contain exactly 1 item.

generation_metadata.description: Tracking metadata from the generation run.

L1Source.description: L1 traceability node — the top-level source document.

id.description: Unique identifier for this source document node in Neo4j.

path.description: File path relative to project root.

screen_id.description: SRS-derived Screen ID. Present for UIBlueprint and APIContracts documents.

BoundingBox.description: Screen zone mapping. For Stage 5a, zone_id is always FULL_SCREEN.

controls.description: Control names from S.3 that belong to this bounding box zone.

s3_row_refs.description: S.3 section IDs (L2 node IDs) that this bounding box encompasses.

highlight_color.description: Hex color code for UI overlay rendering.

FeatureFunction.description: A sub-operation mapped 1:1 to an S.5 event. Sets the ceiling for Stage 5b story generation.

label.description: Concise business sub-feature TITLE (one line) using domain vocabulary; verbatim event token retained in trailing parentheses for traceability.

description.description: Optional 2-3 sentence business explanation of the sub-feature (what the user can do / what the system delivers), grounded in the S.5 event evidence. Populated by the Stage-5a function-label polish pass; absent when polish is disabled.

l2_source_ref.description: L2 ID of the S.5 event or API endpoint this function maps to.

BusinessContext.description: Describes the legacy baseline and the modern target state.

current_state.description: Description of the legacy artifact and its current user behavior.

target_state.description: Description of the modern equivalent (e.g. React component, REST API).

SRSEvidence.description: Physical routing data for the UX split-window viewer. Populated deterministically by the Python Linker.

l2_id.description: The logical L2 ID that triggered this mapping.

section_anchor.description: String for the UI to scroll to, e.g., 'S.5 Event #1'.

highlight_type.description: Indicates whether the UI should highlight a whole section block or a specific table row.

target_string.description: The exact string the UI should highlight.

ManifestFeature.description: The single Feature object produced by Stage 5a.

description.description: One-paragraph description of the feature's business purpose.

source.description: Citation of the specific SRS document/section.

l2_sources.description: L2 section IDs this Feature was derived from.

functions.description: Sub-functions mapped from S.5 events. Must be empty if is_infrastructure=true.

srs_evidence.description: Physical routing data mapping feature-level l2_sources to physical files and UI anchors. Populated by the post-generation linker.

is_infrastructure.description: True if this feature is a utility, OS bridge, Win32 wrapper, or system-level NVO with no direct user-visible business value. If true, story_budget must be 0 and category must be 'Infrastructure'.

condensation_note.description: Required when is_infrastructure=true. Also used when a user-facing feature has bundled infrastructure content that is suppressed from story generation.

srs_section_scope.description: List of ALL SRS sections covering this MFU (full scope since 1 feature = full MFU). Stage 5b uses this for story derivation context.

correction_applied.description: True if at least one corrector pass was applied during generation.

status_detail.description: Structured detail bag for the final_status. Keys vary by status type.

fallback_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the deterministic fallback path was taken. Populated only when final_status=PASS_DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK.
